mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (${columns}) VALUES #{value} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ${updates}

INSERT INTO sys_mock_dataset_state (id, dataset_key, dataset_version, content_sha256, applied_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{datasetKey}, #{datasetVersion}, #{checksum}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE dataset_version = VALUES(dataset_version), content_sha256 = VALUES(content_sha256), applied_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_org WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent_id = 0 AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0
SELECT MAX(org_name) FROM sys_org WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{organizationId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_config c JOIN sys_dict_type t ON t.id = c.category_id AND t.tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.dict_code = #{categoryCode} AND c.config_key = #{configKey} AND t.status = 1 AND t.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0
